metas.name: Toxic
metas.description: A powerful drug cartel pulls the strings behind a facade of sun-soaked beaches as a gritty, violent underworld power struggle emerges during the crumbling of Portuguese colonial rule.

metas.name: Premada Oorali
metas.description: Premada Oorali is a heartfelt love story set in picturesque villages in the 2020s. The film intertwines romance and family drama, exploring the relationships between a father and son, as well as a boy and girl, as they navigate through intriguing, yet relatable, relationship challenges.

metas.name: Kantara - A Legend: Chapter 1
metas.description: While exploring Kantara's mystical forest, Bangra's King Vijayendra dies during the Kadamba reign. Rajashekara seals their realm. Prince Kulashekara massacres to reopen it. Berme, seeking wealth, crosses the divide.

metas.name: K.G.F: Chapter 1
metas.description: A period drama set in the 1970s, KGF follows the story of a fierce rebel who rises against the brutal oppression in Kolar Gold Fields and becomes the symbol of hope to legions of downtrodden people.

metas.name: Roshagni
metas.description: Roshagni is an action revenge drama featuring breathtaking real stunts. The film's protagonist is driven by a quest for vengeance, navigating a story filled with intense action and drama.

metas.name: K.G.F: Chapter 2
metas.description: The blood-soaked land of Kolar Gold Fields (KGF) has a new overlord now - Rocky, whose name strikes fear in the heart of his foes. His allies look up to Rocky as their Savior, the government sees him as a threat to law and order; enemies are clamoring for revenge and conspiring for his downfall. Bloodier battles and darker days await as Rocky continues on his quest for unchallenged supremacy.

metas.name: Saaku Magalu
metas.description: 1963 Kannada movie starring Dr. Rajkumar and Sowcar Janaki in lead roles. It was directed by B.R. Pantulu.

metas.name: Aralida Hoovugalu
metas.description: The story follows Vijaykumar (Shivarajkumar), a college boy who falls in love with his classmate, Sudha (Vidyashree). Their romance hits a major roadblock when Vijaykumar discovers that Sudha's family has a long-standing, bitter dispute with his own family.

metas.name: Anna From Mexico
metas.description: Anna From Mexico Is Upcoming Kannada Movie Directed by Shankar Guru.

metas.name: 777 Charlie
metas.description: Dharma is stuck in a rut with his negative and lonely lifestyle and spends each day in the comfort of his loneliness. A pup named Charlie who is naughty and energetic which is a complete contrast with the Dharma’s character enters his life and gives him a new perspective towards it.

metas.name: Bangarada Jinke
metas.description: A young man sets out on a treasure hunt to capture a golden deer with magical powers. However, he soon learns secrets from his past life which shock him.

metas.name: KD – The Devil
metas.description: In the early 1970s, a petty criminal Kaali unwittingly involves himself with underworld thugs, catalyzing events beyond his control.

metas.name: Border Diaries
metas.description: Set in an industrial area on the Karnataka-Tamil Nadu border, the story explores the lives of people working there and focuses on emotional borders, love, morality, and survival.

metas.name: Hagalu Vesha
metas.description: Hagalu Vesha is a 2000 Indian Kannada -language film directed, written and scripted by Baraguru Ramachandrappa starring Shiva Rajkumar and Reshma.

metas.name: Dia
metas.description: Dia tells the story of a young, introvert girl whose routine life brightens up when she falls for Rohith, one of her fellow college mates. Being an introvert girl and trying to express her love becomes the biggest challenge of her life. This romantic drama will make you lose yourself in the emotional journey of a girl falling in love.

metas.name: Yellow Board
metas.description: Journey through the lives of Bangalore's taxi drivers and their struggles, and how a hero will rise among them.

metas.name: Kantara
metas.description: Shiva, a tribal vagabond lives with his mother in hamlet, stays away from the traditional Daivaradhane and Bhoota Kola legacy due to an unforgettable childhood incident. He is happy loafing around with his friends and doing petty jobs for his landlord. When Forest officer Murali enters the scene, it gives a fresh dimension to the man-vs-nature fight. Can Shiva save the forest from Murali? Or is Murali just a dummy bait cast by bigger fish?

metas.name: Martin
metas.description: Martin revolves around Lt. Brigadier Arjun Saxena, whose journey takes him from Pakistan to India to discover his real identity and fight against black market dealers, who are involved with terrorists to orchestrate massive attacks in the country.

metas.name: Mahavatar Narsimha
metas.description: Tyrannical demon Hiranyakashyap challenges Vishnu, proclaiming himself a god. However, his son Prahlad remains devoted to Vishnu, who appears as Narsimha to defeat the demon.

metas.name: Ghattada Bhoota
metas.description: The film follows a deeply grounded human story that gradually unfolds into a world of mystery, folklore and the unexplained.

metas.name: Amartha
metas.description: After 25 years, village schoolmates reunite to find themselves in vastly different stages of life. Their journey makes them question whether hard work alone determines destiny, or whether an unseen force called Time shapes every fate.

metas.name: Bhale Raja
metas.description: Bhale Raja is a 1969 Kannada film which stars Dr. Rajkumar in a lead role.

A captivating new project by Suraj Production and the Magical Composer’s Debut film, #45Themovie is set to redefine the cinema-watching experience with its unique narrative and compelling performances.

metas.name: Bhairathi Ranagal
metas.description: The story revolves around the life of Bhairathi Ranagal's journey from being a law-abiding responsible lawyer to the benevolent crime boss of Karnataka.

metas.name: Bail
metas.description: After a long wait for justice in a case that affected him personally, retired commissioner Vijay Kumar becomes an outlaw who serves justice.

metas.name: Thota Kovi
metas.description: A witty crime-drama set in the western ghats of Karnataka.

metas.name: Eradane Maduve
metas.description: Comedy of errors and a chance of a second marriage.

metas.name: Bete
metas.description: The plot revolves around a protagonist whose prowess in overcoming challenges makes him a legend. The title "Bete" likely refers to his relentless pursuit of enemies, a quality that makes him a powerful and feared figure.

metas.name: Dynamo
metas.description: Rocky, a second year student plans a wild dance to impress the whole college. Rajahuli, the dominant final year student, sees this as a challenge to his authority. A fierce clash brews between Rocky's ambition and Rajahuli's control.

metas.name: Vamsha Jyothi
metas.description: Vamsha Jyothi is a 1978 Kannada film that stars Kalpana in a lead role. It was directed by A. Bhimsingh

metas.name: The Eggs of Timma
metas.description: Timma, a Western Ghat local, seeks funds for his son's education and a new home. Disrupting his belief in spirituality, he goes on to find king cobra's eggs (considered divine) for money on behest of outsiders (Snake Research team).

metas.name: Seetharam Benoy
metas.description: Seetharam, a cop, gets transferred to a remote village in Shimoga Dist Aanegadde finds himself in middle of a bunch of smart yet cruel thieves. The day he takes charge his house gets robbed. Matter of dignity and personal revenge, intense investigation then begins.

metas.name: Full Meals
metas.description: Full Meals movie touches upon Love, Life, and Passion. In the Film, protagonist is a struggling Wedding Photographer who tries to attain his passion and prove himself. In this process he gets entangled in his personal and love life

metas.name: Just Maath Maathalli
metas.description: Siddharth, a singer, embarks on a journey to Singapore to meet and confess his love for Tanu. He meets Adi, a scriptwriter, on his flight and starts narrating the story of his life.

metas.name: Birba Trilogy: Case 2 - Avrn bitt, Ivrn bitt, Ivryaru?
metas.description: Birbal: Case 2: Directed by M.G. Srinivas. With Shreelakshmi Bhat, M.G. Srinivas.

metas.name: Dakota Express
metas.description: Owners of a bus, Krishna and Sundar, face numerous problems due to poor conditions. However, their life takes a turn when the daughter of the minister takes refuge in their bus.

metas.name: Theertharoopa Thandeyavarige
metas.description: A popular travel vlogger, Prithvi, uncovers a dark secret about his own family. His search for the truth leads him to his estranged father, setting him on a journey of self-discovery.  Does Prithvi Find Closure? Does Destination Meet Destiny?

metas.name: Kalyana Mantapa
metas.description: Though Shankara wants to build a wedding hall after breaking his house, the woman residing there, Sudha, objects to the preposterous plan.

metas.name: Modala thedi
metas.description: Sivagnanam works as a bank clerk. Though his pay is meagre, he deals with a lot of cash at the bank. His family consists of his wife Lakshmi, a daughter whose marriage is being negotiated and two school going children. The bank where he works crashes and Sivagnanam is unable to find another job.

metas.name: Love Seasons
metas.description: Revolves around Trust as a powerful force connects people while love quietly grows around it.

metas.name: Avala Neralu
metas.description: Raja returns to his hometown from America and finds out that his father died in a mysterious jeep accident. Not convinced with the facts, he starts to dig deep into his father's death.

metas.name: Nagarjuna
metas.description: Nagarjuna is a 1961 Indian Kannada language film, directed by Y. V. Rao and produced by K. N. Mallikarjuna

metas.name: Bhuvanam Gaganam
metas.description: Bhuvanam Gaganam is a 2025 Kannada language romantic drama film directed by Gireesh Mulimani.

metas.name: Rambo
metas.description: Car brokers Kitty and Premkumar come across a vehicle that contains a corpse. Soon, they learn that the body has a pen drive that holds information about a terrorist plot.

metas.name: Anna Thangi
metas.description: Two siblings turn inseparable after the death of their parents. Things take a turn after they get married to their respective partners.
